criteria.name: Data Completeness
criteria.feedback: Your submission includes all required columns, at least five unique products, and every row is fully filled in with no missing values, demonstrating excellent completeness.

criteria.name: Data Accuracy
criteria.feedback: Your calculations were correct for almost all products, but there's a small error with the Keyboard row (3 × $30 should be $90, not $100). Double-checking each row's math will help you reach full marks next time.

criteria.name: Organization and Formatting
criteria.feedback: Your CSV is excellently structured, with clear headers, correct column order, and consistent formatting throughout, making it easy to read and well-suited for spreadsheet use.
